purpose: Diagnose finite-record native sampling/window-length contribution without replacing the canonical PR #286 observable.

operator.native_sample_interpretation: left-hold: sample y[n] is constant on [n*dt,(n+1)*dt)
operator.endpoint_convention: target interval is exactly [0,T); the final native hold cell is clipped at T; no sample at T is included
operator.integration_rule: exact analytic integral of exp(+i*omega*t) over each clipped hold cell multiplied by the native left sample
operator.pressure_sampling: solver-native pressure samples after the pre-existing pressure conversion; no resampling before observation
operator.source_sampling: same native source trace under the identical clipped zero-order-hold observation operator
operator.reason_linear_trapezoid_not_adopted: The canonical source authority is a discrete unit impulse q[0]=1,q[n>0]=0. Piecewise-linear/trapezoidal reconstruction would redefine that discrete impulse area (endpoint half-weight) unless source semantics were changed. ZOH preserves the existing discrete source semantics while isolating the finite-cell/window overrun.

analytic_fixture.acceptance: relative P_T/Q_T error must strictly decrease at each refinement and finest error must be < 0.11

diagnosis_classification.monotonic_if: aligned second adjacent complex-RMS <= aligned first adjacent complex-RMS
diagnosis_classification.substantially_reduced_if: non-monotone remains but worsening excess ratio ((second/first)-1) is reduced by at least 50% versus canonical
